exclusions.rule: PDF/document upload for conversion, OCR, field extraction, document-to-form generation and a converter UI.
Building a CLI, AI agent, MCP tool or local Claude generation pipeline. Canonical import/export and documented application APIs remain required under ordinary staff authorization.
Mapping answers into PDF fields, coordinates or document templates; PDF filling, generation or document-processing pipelines.
Certinal or other legally binding e-sign orchestration, signer handoff, signing-status verification or signed-document delivery.
Payment collection, appointment scheduling, CRM/HR/clinical workflows and general business-process automation. Core calculated values and generic integration contracts remain in scope.
An unconstrained conversational agent, typed-question interface, answer dictation or voice-driven answer changes. Compact narration and spoken approved-help questions remain in scope.

normativeApiOperations.countingRule: One O_named operation equals one distinct HTTP method plus canonical path from the four explicit endpoint tables; query examples are not part of the path.

namedSupportingOperations.countingRule: O_total named inventory is O_named plus precisely these separately cited PRD-named operations; it does not assign a route to the authorized asset API.

operationFieldContract.method: Canonical uppercase HTTP method. This replaces the legacy `verb` field.
operationFieldContract.path: Canonical leading-slash path without presentation whitespace; null only when the PRD names an API without method/path.
